decisions.reason: As an extension of the popular Demeter dairy range that remained on the website into 2024, this product is close to the core business, already carries visible commitment, and any weaker-than-hoped traction can still be treated as a temporary market-building issue rather than a reason to reverse course.

This cheese launch is very recent, close to the firm's established organic dairy strengths, and publicly presented on its own page, so management influenced by escalation of commitment would be reluctant to withdraw before giving the invested resources and market introduction more time to pay off.

Because this newly launched sliced butter cheese is also a visible 2024 introduction in a core category for the firm, management would likely continue it, justifying the investment and attributing any early shortcomings to normal launch-phase adjustment in a growing food market.
